job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibility


Design and develop high-quality, scalable, and efficient backend systems.
Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate backend services with web applications.
Develop and maintain databases using SQL and NoSQL technologies.
Implement robust security measures to protect against potential threats and vulnerabilities.
Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
Troubleshoot issues and debug code to resolve problems efficiently.
Job Requirements

Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, or Perl.
Experience with frameworks like Spring Boot, Django, Ruby on Rails, Laravel, or CodeIgniter.
Strong understanding of database concepts including data modeling and normalization.
Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with colleagues.
Work with Node.js, Express and databases to build APIs.
